# generate-plugin

Generate a new plugin to extend Balda's functionality.

```bash
npx balda generate-plugin auth -p src/plugins/security
```

**Generated file:** `src/plugins/security/auth.ts`

## Flags

- `-p, --path <string>`: Target directory (default `src/plugins`)
